[EN] I really don't know which way to turn first. The faeries suffer, the animals, the flowers. And I suffer with them.
[ES] De verdad no sé a dónde acudir primero. Las hadas sufren, los animales, las flores. Y yo sufro con ellos.

[EN] I hope we meet again.
[ES] Espero que nos volvamos a ver.
